one hundred and seventy-one stood exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, the fire missing its fifth with its payer unnamed for a hundred and seventy-one days and the river keeping its fifth low note through the door, three counts in three places and none becoming the others.
Day 172 | Tallow 23, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday) | the Clay Yard, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the yard well, the kindling and flagstones, the clay road, and the Vail kiln-house hearth, loaf shelf and bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The last working week came into its third day with the kilns already at their heat and the yard smelling of a thing held at a temperature it would not stay at, the danger of the month in the dust ground small as meal, the sweetish edge of lead glaze riding up from High Kiln on a wrong wind and the kiln's breath in fours with its gap, a wet pot giving its high thin note before its time which the boy filed as a danger and not as a fourth near-full answer, no room changed and no pot lost (T088, T061/T082); Tarn took the broom only after it had been given its instruction, set the small knife back at the very edge of its sill and told the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count, six standing in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it, his chest tight from the dark, Ash worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist holding what light there was, the warm stone she gave him in the winter Garl died lying cold in its clay pot in the loft, two years gone and not looked at in a year (T036/T076, T006 held); he said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late, agreeing so entirely that no argument could find a foot while going on wanting the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, his broom going over the collector's road without once turning along it and no collector coming, and the sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that held it came up into his teeth and went no further, the breath he should have spent drawn and not spent, the loan uncalled, no tenth stopping stood up before the seventh year was earned and something waiting to give at the end of a term that was not yet ended (T036/T076, T061/T082); at the well a woman's question about what the kilns would want now the last week was in was answered with the heat kept, the pot and the river and no figure, and the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates and the field's empty place with a look and a wide step and no number (T077, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Sella told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist and set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand without touching the widow's mark, because a morning and a shelf are not openings (T058/T079); the surgeon's register read the held breath as a clamp left too long and the near-saying stopped at the word as a chart closed over its finding with the neat margin showing, exact and worth nothing at two paces, an inventory that was not a key and a list that was not a hand; at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road, woodsmoke before her and river wind behind, going wide around the pan's gone place, the bare dark trough and the space beneath the rack, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen and unwiped, let her hand rest a half-beat longer than the setting needed and went to her own bed, the two rooms not touching; in the small hours he laid out the file with six hearings and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and not paid, nine stoppings with no payer named, the damper as one iron with two bites joined to no kiln, the two shut-room tellings with no third, the told bell beside the heard, and the third movement of the equality on Tallow 22 on a third place beside the Day 161 fraction and the Day 166 held beat --- three held changes and not a doctrine, no finger of his drawing the line between the shelf's two gaps, the crust's empty place, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T060/T086, T097, T062/T100); cold came cheek, temple, wrist and stopped, and one hundred and seventy-two stood exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, the payer under the floor without a name for a hundred and seventy-two days, the charcoal waiting under the shelf for a hand that was not his and a day that had not come, as his hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water and came down against the fold.

Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, said the house where another woman would say I, kept her half-pace, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze without touching it, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, let her hand rest a half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the widow's mark untouched, for a morning and a shelf are not openings (T058/T079); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T097/T098 carried), while a rack woman reached past the bare board with her hand before her eyes found the basket and two neighbours' cold and wet-under-it ended in weather; Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while going on wanting the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, six counted in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the knife, the ear-sentence up into his teeth and no further, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his stroke over the collector's road without once turning along it and no collector coming, the half-check of Tallow 22 left where it was and not repeated (T036/T076, T061/T082); the month's danger took its order in dust ground small as meal, the sweetish lead edge riding a wrong wind off High Kiln and a pot giving its thin note before its time, which the boy filed as a danger and not as a fourth near-full answer, no pot lost, no room changed, the firing read as a theatre he could not enter with heat kept and counted behind a screen and a gate of two bites, his file exact and worthless, an inventory that is not a key and a list that is not a hand, and one hundred and seventy-three standing exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool while the charcoal waited under the shelf for a hand that was not his and a day that had not come.
Day 174 | Tallow 25, Y.H. 813 (Fifthday) | the Vail wheel-shed, the cold damper, the flagstones, the drying racks and the yard well in the Clay Yard, the back room (not entered), the kiln-house hearth and the bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | Before first grey three or four men came up with their collars high and went low through the finger's-width door of the back room and Sella Vail carried past at the half-pace, turned no head, gave the house no name for them and did not say the room was cold, while the boy did not count men who had been given no name and the two tellings of a counting room shut in the war stood side by side with no third (T035/T031, T065/T095); Jorra Vail came through with fine grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bent little finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist had opened and not bone-coloured slip, kept dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray and asked neither which slate had been broken nor whether it was a birth-slate, the broken birth-slates lying under the lowest rack and entered by nobody; he spoke to the wheel before anyone (It doesn't care whose hands. Day 175 | Tallow 26, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday) | the yard well, the drying racks, the worked strips, the loaf shelf and hearth under the Vail kiln-house roof, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | Midday stood in the Clay Yard with the heat held in the clay and the oiled paper lifting at the kiln-house windows, Sella Vail carrying the boy at the half-pace with instruction to the wool, the running water and the river wind and never to the basket, and a neighbour with a pot just out of the tubs asking what a firing cost set down in the Vail house being answered, after one glance at the cold glazed jar and a hand that shut half over nothing without touching it, with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. two neighbours settled the morning between a cold and a wet one under it and the argument ended in weather with nobody owning either day, while the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lay and the empty place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number, dry slip dust fine as meal in the creases of a fist and the sweetish lead edge off High Kiln coming and going on a wrong wind, entered in nothing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); under the roof the underside of the loaf shelf became a roof over the basket and Sella stood with her back to it, moving her lips along her row with two unnamed gaps, giving nobody a figure, while a rack woman put two bare boards and a child's appetite under one appetite in one breath and the boy kept the shelf's two gaps, the fold's crust and its empty place, the pan's gone ring on its own tray and the field's empty place in four rooms and on four trays that did not touch, no third gap coming, no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger of his drawing the line (T060/T086, T097); the charcoal waited under the shelf's front edge unread and uncounted, her finger not going beneath the board, so the Day 166 held beat stood where it had been left, and the boy did not read, count or copy the marks, which waited for a hand that was not his and a day that had not come (T100 carried, not paid); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road, woodsmoke before her and river wind behind, going wide around the pan's gone place, the bare dark trough, the rack space and the missing hand's place without explaining the turns, and under the roof set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen, let her hand rest a half-beat longer, told the fire it was the thaw, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and left the widow's mark untouched, because a dusk is not an opening and the two rooms do not touch; the cold arriving cheek, temple and wrist stopped at the wrist with the afterdrop waiting, and one hundred and seventy-five stood exact, complete and unspent while the fire missed its fifth with its payer unnamed for a hundred and seventy-five days.
Day 176 | Tallow 27, Y.H. 813 (Seventhday) | the Clay Yard and the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the yard well, the kindling and flagstones under the Vail roof, the loaf shelf and the bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The last tend stood at its heat with the yard smelling of a thing held between two hands that would not stay held, the danger of the month in dust ground small as meal on the sill and white in the whites of knuckles, the sweetish edge of lead glaze riding a wrong wind off High Kiln and the kiln's breath in fours with its gap, an order and no name that could not be carried into a chart, a rack woman's pot giving its thin early sound filed where a danger goes and not among the three near-full answers or the six hearings, no pot lost and no room changed (T061/T082); he said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while going on wanting the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, his stroke going over the collector's road without once turning along it and no collector coming, and the sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that held it came up into his teeth and went no further, the breath he should have spent drawn and not spent, the loan uncalled and no tenth stopping stood up before the seventh year was earned, because an account stood up before its hour is an account with a payer already written in and no payer stood here; the boy kept the fraction at the damper, the beat beneath the loaf shelf and the flagstone half-check on three places and added nothing to them, for a hand held back from the iron is still a hand that knows where the iron stands and a hand that waits a second and third time is holding, not making the change twice over (T062/T100/T036/T076); under the roof Sella told the carried fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and did not touch the widow's mark, and the surgeon's register read the held breath as a clamp left too long on a vessel that would not bear the taking off and the near-saying stopped at the word as a chart closed over its finding with the neat margin showing, exact and worth nothing at two paces; one hundred and seventy-six stood exact, complete and unspent while the fire missed its fifth with its payer unnamed for a hundred and seventy-six days and the charcoal waited under the shelf for a hand that was not his and a day that had not come.
Day 177 | Tallow 28, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday) | the clay road at the going of the light, the Vail kiln-house bed, hearth and loaf shelf's low angle, under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | Sella Vail carried the boy home up the clay road at the going of the light with woodsmoke going before her in long low bars and river wind coming up behind with the taste of water over water, the two passing on the stair of the evening without taking each other's colour or spending a word on either, the carrying arm keeping the weight in muscle and giving no account of the cost, and went wide around the pan's gone place, the bare dark trough, the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lay and the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, giving none of the turns to the basket and saying nothing of them (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); under the roof she set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, base first and the weight settled the way a woman sets a vessel that must not rock, put the fold right without looking at his face, left the thread frozen, let her hand rest a half-beat longer than the setting needed --- the half-beat learned in the winter she sat up three nights with a child of her own who cooled while everybody was kind and never told anybody --- told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and left the widow's mark untouched, for a dusk is not an opening and the two rooms do not touch (T058/T079); in the small hours he turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel before a case begins, each thing into its own hollow and nothing resting across anything else, six hearings of the full note beside and never among --- five from four sources and the sixth, the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted, where a thing from a person must go --- with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers advanced and not paid with the wheel-keeper's withheld knowing among them and not among the hearings, the older intervals at Stone 13, 17 and 25, nine stoppings as objects and not a rule with no payer named to any and no tenth before the seventh year was earned, the damper as one iron with two bites joined to no kiln and no Grathic word for both mercies (T061/T082, T036/T076, T062); the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 held beat beneath the shelf and the Day 171 flagstone half-check stood on three places and not as a pair or a doctrine, the two shut-room tellings stood with no third, the told bell beside the heard bell, the sixth green a colour joined to no ear and the foundling a shape with no sale, and no third gap came and no fourth likeness made a cause; Day 178 | Tallow 29, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday) | the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the loaf shelf, the wheel-shed edge, the cold damper, the flagstones, the kindling and the bed under the Vail kiln-house roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The last working day of Tallow came in with hot dry clay over the Yard and the sour breath of the unswept corner under the sweet dry smell, the kilns brought to their last heat of the month and nobody speaking a date over the basket, the danger keeping an order and no name in meal-fine dust, a pot's early note at the kiln mouth and the sweetish edge of lead glaze riding the wrong wind off High Kiln, a potter telling a cup it would do and the cup standing where it was set and not lost, no lesson made and no room changed (T077, T061/T082); Day 179 | Tallow 30, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the third Account-day and last market of Tallow) | the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post's finger's width of shade, the pot board and stalls, the north bridge and the out-of-line landing, the clay road, the Vail kiln-house bed, hearth and loaf shelf under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The third Account-day and the last market of Tallow came up over the Cross with river wind under the eaves and hot clay coming down on the same breath from High Kiln, the boy one hundred and seventy-nine days old and five months and twenty-nine days and the only thing in the square that kept the number (T071/T072); **the chapter's one meaningful change:** Sella Vail set the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, base first and the weight settled, and stepped back half a pace and stood through the forenoon and into the afternoon, giving the basket no instruction, no reason and no word about why the strip under the post was other than the place a pace to the left where the crowd leaned over the reading block, and at the going of the light she came back for it, the shade gone a finger up the post, and lifted it base first and level from the side the iron had not cooled (T058/T079); Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, saying The levy is called. It is not called by me and A number goes into a slate, not a bundle. If your house wants it again, there'll be a slate at the watch --- your house, never I --- and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness, so that the district's arithmetic changed for the month and settled nothing, the printed figure standing unchallenged, the figure read aloud still not the figure paid, and the figure going into the slate not knowing the hand that went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T015/T041/T047, T077, T098 carried); the bell went four, four and a gap longer than a church bell with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told, and the river's fifth low note under the bridge kept apart from the fire's missing fifth at home (T078); Hessa Rale came through before noon toward Greybank with Berr's narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, her hand to it before her eyes went to the crowd, telling the woman who asked I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, no figure coming off the slate and her record-first reaching filed as the eighth such hand in the district, advanced and not paid and joined to none (T080); below the bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, slate turned inward and hand to it before eyes to stalls, nobody stepping around him or taking him off (T090); across the square a silent woman with clay under her nails, a pale line across the back of one hand and the sweetish green of lead glaze at her mouth turned a cup a quarter and set it back where it stood and went off with the light, the sixth green kept a colour joined to no ear and never Fenna in narration, and at the market's edge the foundling was not seen, a shape with no sale and his sixth glimpse unspent, no loaf passing and no slate opened within reach of the basket (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); in the small hours the file was exact and worthless --- six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and not paid, nine stoppings as objects with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, three held changes on three places, the two shut-room tellings with no third and the told bell beside the heard --- with no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger of his drawing the line, and one hundred and seventy-nine stood exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, the payer under the floor without a name for a hundred and seventy-nine days, the fire missing its fifth, the charcoal waiting under the shelf for a hand that was not his and a day that had not come, and the firing month going out without a boundary drawn, forward into Ember.
Day 180 | Ember 1, Y.H. 813 (Firstday) | the Clay Yard and the kiln mouth, the drying racks and the wheel-shed edge, the flagstones, the Vail kiln-house hearth, loaf shelf and bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The kiln month opened without a boundary drawn while the district kept calling Tallow the firing month and Ember the kiln month and neither was corrected, the boy one hundred and eighty days old and six months exactly with nobody under any roof saying so, hot clay coming into the room before the grey and wet wool under it and the sour breath of the unswept corner under both, while Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, the fire, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket, said *the house* where another woman would say *I*, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze without touching it, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, and at the kiln mouth put her hand to the widow's mark **before** the kiln, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid and tipped the carried coal under the back of a broken pot so the fire took and answered four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for a hundred and eighty days, nobody praising the opening and nobody seeing what it mended (T058/T079 advanced, not paid; T088, T071/T072); the yard went around the clean dark line where Ash had turned and the finer grey called the thaw beside it, the broken birth-slates under the lowest rack, the pan's gone ring and the empty place in the returning line where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried), while Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the kindling *Six counted. Day 182 | Ember 3, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday) | the Clay Yard and the kiln mouth, the drying racks and the yard well, the wheel-shed edge, the flagstones, the kindling, the loaf shelf, the Vail kiln-house hearth and the bed under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The third day of the kiln month came in without anybody marking where the second had ended and the second working day was ordinary tending, the kiln drawing breath behind the wall in fours with a gap and the carried fire under the floor answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer without a name for a hundred and eighty-two days, the river keeping its note of water over water through the finger's-width door as a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings and the boards keeping four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- three counts in three places that did not become one (T088, T061/T082); the month's danger had an order and no name and could not be carried into a chart, hot clay under tallow, fine grey slate dust ground small as meal sitting white in the crease of a knuckle when a fist opens, the sweetish edge of lead glaze riding up from High Kiln on a wrong wind, and a pot set down wrong on a rack's edge giving its high thin note before its time, which the woman who set it down did not hear, the boy turning his head toward the note and getting no further, having no knuckle to set against it and no word to tell anybody, and filing it where a danger goes and not among the near-full answers because a note out of season is a fault in the handling and not a fourth likeness waiting to be promoted (T077, T061/T082); Jorra came through with dust in both forearms, kept dusty and clean ones on one tray, told the wheel it cared for steady hands and a pot it would do, knew its note three turns ahead and kept the knowing back from a kiln-hand on the wrong wind who said a pot singing early generally sings itself out early, and no third telling came of the counting room shut in the war though the man had a saying about a pot, a saying about a pot being not a saying about a room (T035/T031, T065/T095); a neighbour asking what the second day's firing wanted with the kiln newly open was sent to the pot and the weather with *Ask the weather. It cares if they're steady, told a pot You'll do, knew its full note three turns ahead and withheld it from a man come up on the wrong wind, no pot lost and no lesson made, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered holding and not a change made again (T061/T082, T062); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the kindling Six counted. The next I don't count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, Ash worked into his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, swept the collector's road without turning with no collector coming, and brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there with no figure and no name, nine stoppings still nine, no tenth before the seventh year was earned, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076); the stone lay back in its unmarked pot in the loft cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiving, and the charcoal waited unread beneath the shelf with Sella's finger kept from beneath the front edge (T006, T100), and in the small hours the carried man's pale line lay on a place of its own while one hundred and ninety stood exact, complete and unspent and the count went forward.

the crust lay leathery two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the drool thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint at the wrist where the wool rode back, and the afterdrop waited on a warming nobody in this house would perform, while Sella gave the instruction to wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale off the coals, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, and left the mark hanging because there had been no opening since before the kiln on Ember 1 (T058/T079); it, kept her finger from beneath the shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, fed him barley gruel from the house's own dish with the spoon wiped on her sleeve and not his mouth, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with the half-beat at the setting, counted under her breath toward no opening and left from a man come up on a wrong wind who said a pot singing before its time generally sings itself out early --- the saying staying a saying about a pot and not made true as a lesson, no pot lost --- and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's unfinished sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); at the kiln mouth the sweet edge of lead glaze pale line at his gum lying on a place of its own, exact, complete and worth nothing at two paces, with no offstage fate invented for him (T064 held); neighbours asking what the firing would want now the account had gone up the road were sent to the pot and the weather and went away level, the printed one in twelve standing unchallenged, Berr's box gone up the road locked with the true subtraction inside, Hessa's narrow slate unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed with a look and a wide step and no number, no third gap coming and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092/T098); at the going of the light she carried him home up the clay road with woodsmoke before and river wind behind and went wide around the absences, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, banked the coals with the back of a broken pot and did not touch the mark because a dusk is not an opening, and in the small hours he turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel --- six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh in a hundred and ninety-seven days, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, nine stoppings with no tenth, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth and the pale line on a fifth, the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the pan's gone ring and the field's empty place on trays that do not touch, the warm stone cold in its loft pot, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled --- and then the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger's-width door and **did not come down at once but stayed up through the whole of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch this one --- the small intake, the hold, and on into the letting go --- and came down with the breath rather than before it, against the fold**, the longest holding yet, a coordination and not a reach, not a greater reach and not a stronger hand, filed on a place of its own beside the others and never laid across them, not a reaching, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not one of the three held changes, not a key, not a power and not a rule, with no payer named and no doctrine stood up out of it, while he still could not close the two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number, the body humiliating him and moving by an inch at the same time, and one hundred and ninety-seven standing exact, complete and unspent in the dark of the wool, nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended, the count going forward into Day 198, Ember 19 (T071/T072, T061/T082, T088).

at the kindling Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, six counted in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and the nine stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year was earned, his stroke going over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning, no collector coming (T036/T076); Day 199 | Ember 20, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the second Account-day and market-day of Ember) | the Cross, the reading block, the moot-post's finger's width of shade, the pot board and stalls, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the clay road, the Vail kiln-house roof at the hearth, loaf shelf, kindling and bed, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The kiln month's second Account-day and market came up over the Cross with the boy one hundred and ninety-nine days old and six months and nineteen days and nobody saying so, Tallow still the firing month and Ember the kiln month and neither corrected, the carried fire's payer unnamed for a hundred and ninety-nine days and river, fire and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail set the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, stood half a pace off, gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never the basket, kept her hand from the mark because a reading was not an opening, and did not look into the basket (T058/T079); two hundred leaned to the reading block and eight pigs went over the wet boards while the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard kept beside the told (T078); **the chapter's one meaningful change:** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd --- the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- said The levy is called. across the square a silent woman with clay under her nails, a pale line across the back of one hand and green in the crease beside her lip turned a cup a quarter and went off with the light, the sixth green a colour joined to no ear and never Fenna in narration (T050/T051 held), and at the market's edge a small shape in cast-offs with silt dried pale in its wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string at its throat stopped its half-beat toward a pot and rubbed the sliver, unnamed, silent, no loaf, slate or sale and not a seventh sighting (T033/T034 held); Berr's twice-wiped thumb, Hessa's hand to the slate and the clerk's hand to his slate lay on places of their own, two inward records still two inward records, and a row of such hands would call itself an account (T080/T090); carried home at the going of the light with woodsmoke before and river wind behind, Sella went wide around the pan's gone ring, the bare trough, the rack space, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, a neighbour's cost-question going to the pot and the weather and away level (T009/T013/T092, T098, T077); under the roof the figure had not crossed the wall, and in the small hours the hand outside the wool went up an inch and came down at once with no holding in it, the asking not always answered, the miss filed on the sixth place beside the holdings, not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, key, power or rule, with one hundred and ninety-nine exact and unspent in the wool and the market's figure not entered anywhere under the roof (T061/T082).

Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing without a touch, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, fed him from the house's own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow's mark where it had hung since the first firing, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour's cost-question about the firing went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); at the kindling Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept nine stoppings with no tenth, his stroke over the flagstones without the half-check and over the collector road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, the two shut-room tellings staying two, and Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger, not bone-coloured slip, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, told the wheel it cared only for steady hands and a pot it would do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead from a man on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot, held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, and kept he's not Vail sealed with the promise of the boy's name ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T064, T065/T095); asked in the morning the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the river's note and came down at once, the asking not always answered and the miss no failure, and in the small hours it went up and held for the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, each answer filed on the sixth place beside the others as not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, change, key, power or rule with no payer named, while he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number, and two hundred and four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Day 205 (T061/T082).
Day 205 | Ember 26, Y.H. 813 (Sixthday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks, the wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The word of the burned slate was the day's one change and it came up from Slate Row before the grey, spoken over the boards of the yard and not to the basket, a voice on the river wind saying that a slate had burned in the night and then going on to the price of barley and the weather, with no owner named, no room, no hand at the flame and no reason, and nobody in the yard turning it into a cause; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set it on a place of its own beside the dust off Jorra's forearms and the two tellings of the shut counting room, with a hand between the three, a direction arriving from a place, passing over boards and arriving nowhere, not a hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, fourth likeness or third telling and not carried into any chart a clerk would keep, advanced and not paid (T035/T031, T065/T095); the boy came into his two hundred and fifth day and six months and twenty-five days with nobody saying so, the fire's fifth without a payer for two hundred and five days and the river's fifth note, the kiln's four-and-a-gap and the boards' four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the crust leathery two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, and the afterdrop waiting, while Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the child, said the house, kept her half-pace, glanced once at the clay jar without a touch, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, fed him from her own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, counted under her breath toward no opening and left the widow's mark untouched, for a word over the boards and a slate burning in another quarter were not openings and there had been none in twenty-five days (T058/T079, T100); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey dust under the bent finger, grew quieter by a degree when the word went around the boards so that the household straightened around the quiet without an order, gave the house no name for anything, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot, withheld the full note known three turns ahead from a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying and cost no pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot, a remembered repetition, with the damper read as one iron with two bites and he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on that wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the same wind, a second direction on the same day answered as a direction and entered nowhere, no second edge paid, no pot lost and no lesson stood up out of a breath of air (T064); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists and a man off the clay road with a number shut in his fist asked what the pots and the kiln would want with the last tend running, and both were sent to the pot, the house and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered, the man's number arriving nowhere, while the figure of the second reading stood offstage in Berr's locked box with the true subtraction inside, Hessa's slate unread at Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set for his uncalled measure (T077, T015/T041/T047/T080/T090 held); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, and Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth, and swept past the bright patch and the collector road without turning while no collector came (T036/T076); in the morning the hand went up an inch and held for the small intake only, coming down before the letting go, and in the small hours it stayed through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of a breath counted at Sella's fire in the room that does not touch his and came down with the breath --- the old coordination remembered, not a change made again --- each answer filed on its sixth place and laid across nothing, while he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number and two hundred and five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Day 206 (T061/T082).

the household kept Garl at its closest yet to the end of the tend and kept him in objects --- the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, the seat with its twenty-year hollow, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw gone around with a look and a wide step and neither swept, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, worse for being uncalled because it could be neither paid nor settled nor stopped, no collector called and no lesson made of any of it (T009/T013/T092); hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour corner breath, the leathery crust stiff two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist joint, the afterdrop waiting, and his wanting to be told had gone so quiet he could no longer hear it asking though it was there all the same; Sella Vail came to the fire before the basket, told it the grey was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, stood with the back of the pot counting under her breath toward no opening, said The house will keep it where another woman would say I, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, fed him from the house's own dish with the spoon on her sleeve and his mouth unwiped, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, and left the widow's mark where it had hung since the first firing, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in twenty-six days (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour with dry scurf on her hem and a pot against her hip asked what the last of the kiln month would want before the account was read and was sent to the pot and the weather, going away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on a wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the same wind, answered as a direction and entered nowhere, and the saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot (T064); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, quieter since the burned-slate word, told the wheel and a pot their sayings, withheld the note from the wrong wind, held his bent finger in the cold damper until the sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, read the iron as one piece with two bites with no Grathic word for both, and kept he's not Vail sealed with the promise of the boy's name ungiven, while the burned-slate word still went around the boards touching everything and belonging to nothing, nobody saying whose slate or which room or why, and the boy keeping it on its own place beside the dust and the two tellings with a hand between the three (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); three or four unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name, and Tarn kept six counted where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept nine stoppings with no tenth, the seventh nearer its end than ever and not given, his stroke over the bright patch and the collector road without the half-check or a turn while no collector came (T036/T076); in the morning the hand went up an inch and came down before the counted breath had finished, an inch let go early and no failure in it, but in the small hours, with Sella gone to her own bed and no count at her fire in the room that does not touch his to hold against, it went up an inch toward the note of water over water through the finger's-width door and stayed up for the length of the river's own low interval, the note drawing out and slackening, and came down on the next low note when the river gave it --- a coordination with the one rhythm through the door, not willed against another count and not a gain in strength, filed on the sixth place beside the others as not a longer reach, not a stronger hand, not a hearing since water over water remained a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, not a seventh, stopping, payment, one of the three held changes, key, power or rule, with no payer named and no sign stood up (T061/T082 advanced and not paid); the file turned out at the close was exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers unpaid, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, the three held changes and the loft scrape and pale line, nine stoppings with no tenth, the absences on trays that did not touch, the carried man's cost entered nowhere and the sixth green a colour and the foundling a shape, and he still could not close two inches, lift the crust or speak a number while two hundred and six stood exact in the dark, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody and the river went on over water without noticing that an inch had ridden one of its low notes, the count going forward into Day 207 (T006, T064, T100, T004).
Day 207 | Ember 28, Y.H. 813 (Eighthday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well, the drying racks, the wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The kiln month's last working week ran on into its eighth morning with no boundary drawn at the turning of the tend and neither month-name corrected, the boy two hundred and seven days old and six months and twenty-seven days and nobody under any roof saying so, the carried fire's fifth without a payer for two hundred and seven days while the river's note of water over water, the kiln's four-and-a-gap and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one, for agreeing them would have wanted a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); a neighbour's cost-question about the firing was sent to the pot and the weather and went away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); at the kindling Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings standing with no tenth and the collector road unswept, no collector coming (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey dust parted from slip, spoke to the wheel before anyone (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), told a pot You'll do, withheld its full note from a man on a wrong wind whose saying stayed a saying and cost no pot, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reached the pot, a remembered holding and not a change made again (T035/T031/T062); the burned-slate word went over the boards and arrived nowhere, and the hand outside the wool went up an inch toward the river's note and came down before the counted breath had finished, a miss filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); Garl was kept in objects to the last working week's end --- the salt coat's broader shape, the seat's hollow, the unswept line and finer grey, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name, no lesson made, no collector called and his name unspoken for two hundred and seven days (T009/T013/T092).
Day 208 | Ember 29, Y.H. 813 (Ninthday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the bare trough, the drying racks, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road's edge, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | A second day of directions came over the boards with no boundary drawn, the boy two hundred and eight days old and six months and twenty-eight days and nobody saying so, the carried fire's fifth unpaid for two hundred and eight days and the river's fifth note, the kiln's four-and-a-gap and the boards' four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the burned-slate word went around the boards a second time, spoken over them and not to the basket, with no owner, room, hand at the flame or reason and the voice going on to the price of barley and the weather, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and filed it again on its own place beside Jorra's dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- a second telling of a direction, still not a third telling of the shut counting room, not a cause and nothing a clerk could chart (T035/T031/T065/T095); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in the creases of a fist, parted dust from slip, spoke to the wheel (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), told a pot You'll do, knew its full note three turns before it left the wheel and withheld it from a man come up on a wrong wind whose saying that a pot singing before its time generally sings itself out early stayed a saying about a pot with no pot lost and no lesson made (T061/T082); the sweet edge of lead glaze came up off High Kiln on that wrong wind, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, answered as a direction and entered nowhere with no second edge paid, no cause named in Grathic and no collector called (T064 held); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in her wrists asked what the pots would want before the last market and a man off the clay road kept his number shut in his fist and paid nothing, both sent to the pot and the weather so nothing was slopped, priced, refused or entered, while the printed one in twelve stood unchallenged and the true subtraction stayed out of reach in Berr Clay's locked box up the road, and the boy sorted the yard in ninety seconds with a competence intact and useless because there was no hand in the basket to carry any of it to a slate (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); Sella Vail gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, kept the half-pace from open slates, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger from beneath the charcoal, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and did not look toward the bed, the widow's mark untouched with no opening in twenty-eight days (T058/T079, T100); at the kindling Tarn told the wood Six counted. Day 209 | Ember 30, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday, the third Account-day and last market of Ember) | the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, the Cross, the reading block and the moot-post's finger's width of shade, the pot board and stalls, the Fishstairs and out-of-line landing below the north bridge, High Kiln, Greybank, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The kiln month's third and last Account-day and last market came up over the Cross with the boy two hundred and nine days old and six months and twenty-nine days and nobody under any roof saying so, no slate in Sarn with a place to enter it, the carried fire's fifth without a payer for two hundred and nine days and the river's fifth low note, the kiln's four-and-a-gap and the boards' four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); Sella Vail carried him down the clay road at the half-pace in the morning with woodsmoke before her and river wind behind, kept the half-pace from every open slate, gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and set him in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay with the cold iron at his cheek, standing half a pace off and saying nothing of the square or the thane's low voice (T058/T079); two hundred leaned to the reading block while eight pigs went over the wet boards with a man and a slate following every pig, and the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told from the Long Night (T078); the chapter's one true change: Berr Clay came up short off the clay road a little before the top of the morning with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd --- the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that come late --- said The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes his hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness, so that the district's arithmetic changed for the third time in the kiln month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure standing unchallenged and a figure read aloud still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047/T077); Berr's twice-wiped thumb joined the record-first hands on the widened tray --- the midwife's reach for a slate before the child, the thane's finger over the figure, the clerk's number before the eyes found the man, the wheel-keeper's word to the wheel, Sella's finger on the shelf's front edge, Hessa's hand to her slate and the soft-cuffed clerk's inward reaching, eight hands going to the record before the person and held apart by hand because a row of eight standing long enough will call itself an account and an account wants a payer, and none stands; Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, her hand arriving before her eyes took the crowd, telling the women who asked what she carried I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, answering the question put and not the one behind it, a runner and not a reader with no figure coming off the slate, her reaching filed as the eighth record-first hand, advanced and not paid (T080); below the north bridge at the Fishstairs on the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, nobody stepping around him or taking him off, the market selling over him as water goes over a stone (T090); the reading answered nothing for the glaze-room hand carried out on Day 188 --- no figure, collector, slate, name, cause or offstage death --- and the pale line stayed on its own place; at the pot board the sixth green stayed a colour, turned a cup a quarter and set it back, and at the market's edge the foundling stayed a shape with a green sliver going dull and a thumb rubbed to it, no seventh of either coming to Ember's last market and neither named as Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the crowd leaned and straightened and went back to its pots and pigs, and the red wool cord went up the clay road folded square under Berr's coat with the box locked and the true subtraction inside; at the going of the light Sella carried him home around the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough, the broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, and set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, fold right and thread frozen (T009/T013/T092/T098); in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, the told bell beside the heard, the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape on a fourth, the pale line on a fifth and the held inch on a sixth, the burned-slate word on its own place and no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause and no finger drawn across them (T061/T082, T100, T060/T086/T097); then, with Sella gone to her bed and no breathing number anywhere in the house, under the very conditions that had given the one-rhythm holding on Day 206, the hand went up an inch toward the river's note and came down at once against the fold --- a miss, the asking not always answered and no failure in the miss --- filed on its sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up to call itself a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); he could not close two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin two inches to the crust or speak a number anybody would believe, and Ember went out without a boundary drawn, two hundred and nine standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid for two hundred and nine days and the count standing ready to go forward into a day nobody under the roof had named.

a neighbour's cost-question about the new month's firing went to the pot and the weather and away level with nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); Tarn told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count with the knife at the sill's edge and Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, and no collector came up or went down the clay road (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You'll do, withheld its full note from a man come up on a wrong wind whose saying about a pot singing early stayed a saying and cost no pot, named no man who went low into the back room before first grey, joined nothing to the two shut-room tellings, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the household kept Garl in objects at the turning --- the salt coat, the hollow seat, the unswept line and finer grey called the thaw, the proverb gone to the pot and the tile debt circled without a name --- with no lesson, no collector and his name unspoken for two hundred and ten days (T009/T013/T092); asked in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the river's note and came down before the counted breath had finished, filed on the sixth place with no payer named and nothing standing up as a power, and in the small hours it held for the small intake only and came down before the letting go (T061/T082).
Day 211 | Grain 2, Y.H. 813 (Secondday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the kiln mouth, the drying racks, the lowest rack and its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the yard well, the bare trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | The firing thinned into the ordinary tending of a year begun without a boundary drawn, so gradual that a man come into the yard at first grey would have said the kiln month had never been a month but one long morning's work, the boy two hundred and eleven days old and six months and thirty-one days with no slate in Sarn, Sill or Grath to enter either number, the carried fire's fifth without a payer for two hundred and eleven days and the river, the boards and the fire keeping three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the yard went around the clean dark line where Ash had turned the corner, the new finer hairline called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the circle the shallow clay pan had left, the bare dark trough whose water was called weather, the field's empty place and the place the carriers crossed, each with a look and a wide step and no number, the house keeping its arithmetic in loaves, glances and the space where a thing had stood (T009/T013/T092, T097/T098 carried); at the yard well a rack woman with slip dried pale in the creases of her wrists asked what the new month's pots would want now the firing was done and was sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered, while a man come off the clay road kept a number shut in his fist, went off up the road with his arithmetic still his own and paid nothing, two directions coming over the boards in one morning and neither landing (T077, T058/T079); The next I don't count with the knife at the sill's lip, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, swept over the flagstones past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, and no collector came (T036/T076); Jorra Vail came through with meal-fine grey slate dust, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, told a pot You'll do, withheld its knowing from a wrong-wind man whose saying stayed a saying, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the burned-slate word on its own place beside the dust and the two tellings with a hand between, and held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reached the pot (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light around the absences with a look and a wide step and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; asked in the morning the hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once against the fold, an honest miss with no failure in it, and in the small hours it stayed for the river's own low interval, the draw, the slack and the small pause, and came down on the river's next low note, the one-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer and nothing standing up as a power (T061/T082).

the burned-slate word came over the boards a fourth time from Slate Row, a voice along the boards where neighbours stood with their baskets, spoken over the boards and not to any basket on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, with nobody saying whose slate, which room, what hand at the flame or why, and the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set it on its own place beside Jorra's dust and the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three --- four tellings of a slate and still not a third telling of the room shut in the war, a voice from a direction not a witness, four tellings not four witnesses to one fire, a direction arrived nowhere, not a cause, hearing, seventh, stopping or payment and nothing a clerk could chart, advanced and not paid; no slate burned under any roof and no fire was lit at the kiln mouth, for a fire would have cost something and the telling cost nothing, and he did not lay the word about a slate across the three sayings about a pot (T035/T031/T065/T095, T061/T082); The next I don't count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, agreed so entirely with the woman who wanted the thaw early and the man who wanted it late that no argument could find a foot and went on wanting the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, counted nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end which had still not given, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, kept the loan uncalled, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, and no collector came on Grain 15, the warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You'll do and withheld its note, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, kept the burned-slate word at four tellings out of Slate Row and the two shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's sentence reached the pot as a remembered repetition, kept the iron's two bites joined to no kiln and entered in no slate, and sealed he's not Vail with the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace with woodsmoke before her in long low bars and river wind behind with water over water, went wide around the clean dark line, the pan's round ring, the bare trough, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the field's empty place, the carriers' place and the returning-line place with a look and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; in the small hours he turned out the file as a man lays instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, three shapings of the pot saying and the burned-slate word on their own places, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid with Grain's first reading still not the figure paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its end, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape gathered and unjoined, and nothing filled to make a row come out even (T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031); then, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, the hand went up an inch toward the note of water over water and stayed, was taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss entered, a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, filed on the sixth place with no payer named and not spent or explained --- and two hundred and twenty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Grain 20 held five mornings off, the first grain covered near the fire and the place in the returning line gone around for the third day and still without a number, and the count went forward into Day 225, Grain 16, Sixthday.

one stiff brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread at his mouth froze and was not wiped, cold stopped at cheek and temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform (T060/T086); Sella came to the fire before the basket, gave every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, said the house, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow's mark untouched with no opening in forty-five days, her private roll unshown and Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour at the door asked what the dressing would take now it was out of the stalk and was told Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, carrying the answer away level with nothing slopped, while a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the water, looked at it and at the woman and the pot, and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); Grain's arithmetic went on unread under the roof --- printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read twice over a basket on Grain 10 still not the figure paid, Berr's true subtraction locked in his box going up toward High Kiln, Hessa's narrow slate up unread toward Greybank and the soft-cuffed clerk still set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called --- three records going inward kept on separate trays and no payer stood under any (T015/T041/T047, T080, T090 held); the seventh green stayed a colour at a silent woman's mouth and the seventh shape a shape at the market's edge, seven mornings gathered with no eighth, no second look joined, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place and set him on his bed with the fold right and the thread frozen, the dressed grain lying thin under its own keeping and the two keepings not laid together;
