Day 229 | Grain 20, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kindling, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the bare trough, the worked strips east of Low Kiln, the clay road, the Cross, the moot-post's finger's width of shade, the reading block, the weighing board, the stalls, the pot board, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, below the north bridge the out-of-line landing, and up the road toward High Kiln and Greybank | the boy came into his two hundred and twenty-ninth day and six months and forty-nine days with nobody saying so, the carried fire's fifth unpaid for the same count and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the second Account-day and market of Grain came, Sella carrying him up at the half-pace from every open slate and setting the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off and giving the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, the square assembling out of boards and noise with the reading block wet at one end, eight pigs waiting on the weighing board, stalls going up with the price of barley and the weather travelling together and two hundred people leaning and straightening before the morning was out (T058/T079); Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure and let his eyes rest a breath longer than the writing required, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, said The levy is called. It is not called by me and to a man at the rail with a number out of a fist said a number goes into a slate and not into a bundle and that if your house wanted it again there would be a slate at the watch, your house never I, taking himself out of his sentence as neatly as a surgeon withdraws a hand, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done the district a kindness (T015/T041/T047); the district's arithmetic changed for the second time in Grain where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, the reading answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 or for the hand that went in on Seed 15 and did not come back, while the dressed grain lay covered under the Vail roof and was read over by a figure that did not know what it cost (T077, T098 advanced and NOT paid); the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told (T078); Hessa Rale went up the clay road before noon with Berr's narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the strap corrected first and then the wrist turned, her coat shortened for the mud with the pale scurf unbrushed, saying I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and to the woman who wanted more Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, no figure coming off the slate and her reaching kept as the eighth such hand, joined to none (T080); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, hand to the slate before eyes to the stalls, a buyer's number going in before he looked up, not stepped around and not taken off (T090); the pot board kept the little print where a cup had been turned a quarter, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch with no eighth, no second look joined, no loaf, no slate, no sale and no name, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced); Sella lifted the basket level at midday and went back at the half-pace, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, and the box went up the road locked answering nothing (T058/T079); back under the roof a neighbour at the threshold asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road stood at the yard well with a number brought up out of a fist, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077); Sella moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow's mark untouched with no opening in forty-nine days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered stopping with no figure and no name, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 20 while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, told a pot You'll do and withheld the note with air under it and a want, let three sayings stand as sayings, kept the burned-slate word at four out of Slate Row and the two shut-room tellings at two, grew quieter under the word, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's sentence as a remembered repetition, sealed he's not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, and Grain 21 stood one morning ahead unbrought (T009/T013/T092/T098); in the small hours he turned out the file again exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, nothing joined, named, opened, called, spent or ended; the hand went up an inch toward the gap at the market's edge, was held through the small intake and the hold with the letting-go still ahead, the thirty-third answer, and in the small hours went up an inch toward the river's note and kept the river's own low interval with no count anywhere in the house to hold it against, coming down on the next low note, the thirty-fourth, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, exact and worth nothing (T061/T082).

one brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze and was not wiped, and cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; the first ordinary tending morning after the reading came with Sella going to the fire before the basket, giving every instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never to the basket, saying the house, telling the fire it was the thaw, turning the coals with a broken pot, counting under her breath toward no opening and pushing coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale; the dressed grain lay under its fold near the hearth counted in glances and handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight, read over the day before by a number that did not know what it had cost and answering nothing for the hand that had gone in on Seed 15 (T077); a wrong wind came up off High Kiln before the light was fully on the flagstones, carried the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green still a colour with no eighth and no name spoken over it, and a voice off the terrace let one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand, a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw, which the boy took apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set back, a saying and not a fourth likeness made a cause, no lesson, no name for what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no pot lost (T064, T050/T051 held, T061/T082); a woman with a pot hitched at her hip asked what the storing would take and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T077); Sella moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and left the widow's mark untouched with no opening in fifty days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn took the broom only after instruction, told the wood Six counted. Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You'll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, let three sayings stand as sayings, kept the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, grew quieter under the word until the household straightened around the quiet without an order, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's sentence as a remembered repetition, and sealed he's not Vail with the promise ungiven, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the morning hand went up an inch toward the note and came down at once under conditions that had once answered, the thirty-fifth answer, and in the middle of the morning a kiln-hand's voice went over the boards with the price of barley behind it; in the afternoon a voice with no owner, room, hand at the flame or cause came back over the boards and asked Which row did the pot go quiet on?, and the weather answered first, the thaw late and grain dear before the month was out, and the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went off up the terrace and the row stood where it stood, a direction arrived nowhere with nobody leaning in to take the answer down; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound, asked for a row, set a row as a place, a place as wanting a witness and a witness as wanting a day when somebody stands somewhere and can be asked, and filed it on a seventh place of its own with a finger between it and the three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings and the count --- NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth telling of the slate, a seed waiting on the far-off day a witness stood somewhere and could be asked (T101 planted and unpaid); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty days and no collector on Grain 21, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, then went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves, so that there was no breathing number anywhere in the house and the two rooms did not touch; in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three sayings, the burned-slate word at four beside the two shut-room tellings with a hand between the three, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, and T101's seed on a seventh place of its own, nothing joined, named, opened, spent or ended; then the hand went up an inch toward the note, was taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths Sella counts at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- two rhythms across a wall, remembered, not a change made again, the thirty-sixth answer filed on the sixth place with no payer named; two hundred and thirty stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, the dressed grain lay covered with no figure over it, the returning-line place went around with a look and no number, the question about the row stood over the boards with nobody to own it, Grain 30 (Day 239) stood nine mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 231, Grain 22, Secondday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101).

**in the middle of the afternoon came the chapter's second advancement, T101 advanced and NOT paid:** a voice with no owner, room, hand at the kiln or cause came over the boards and not into the basket and asked a fourth time Which row did the pot go quiet on?, and the weather answered first with the sweet edge of glaze and the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went off up the terrace toward High Kiln while the row stood where it stood with nobody leaning in to take the answer down; the boy opened it as a surgeon opens a wound --- what it asked, where it stood, what it would want before any man could answer it, who would stand under the answer to pay --- and found no witness at the bottom, then set the fourth telling on the seventh place beside the first three with a finger between each pair and fingers between them and the three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings of the full note and the count, for four askings are not one witness and a witness stands somewhere and can be asked; NOT a fourth shaping of the pot saying, NOT a hearing, NOT a seventh of the full note, NOT a fifth telling of the slate, NOT a third telling of the shut room, NOT a cause, NOT a name and NOT a fifth witness, a seed for the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked, while the three sayings stayed three, the burned-slate word four and the shut-room tellings two and no fifth asking came (T101 advanced, unpaid, T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-eight days and no collector on Grain 29 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came up or went down the clay road while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You'll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, and sealed he's not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while three or more men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand went up an inch toward the river's low note and came down before the letting-go had finished, the fifty-first answer, and in the small hours went up and stayed for the whole of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch his and came down with the breath, the fifty-second, a two-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); two hundred and thirty-eight stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and fifty-eight days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days, the question standing over the boards with four askings and nobody to own them, Grain 30 one morning ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 239, Grain 30, Tenthday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T101).
Day 239 | Grain 30, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday) | the Vail kiln-house at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf's low angle, the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places, the clay road, the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post's thin shade, the pot board, the square, below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing, the fish-trade shade at the market's edge, the walk home at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with Greybank up the road | the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-ninth day and six months and fifty-nine days with nobody saying so, the carried fire's fifth unpaid for two hundred and thirty-nine days and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082), and Grain 30 arrived as the third and last Account-day and market of Grain, one morning ahead at the previous close and now earned; Sella went to the fire before the basket, instructed wool, fire, pot, broom and river wind and never the basket, said The house will keep it, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, left the widow's mark untouched with no opening in fifty-nine days, because a reading is not an opening, and carried him down at the half-pace from every open slate, setting the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of thin shade where no slate lay and standing half a pace off with no instruction or reason given to the basket (T058/T079, T100); **the chapter's one meaningful change came when the district's arithmetic changed for the third time in Grain where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back:** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure and let his eyes rest a breath longer than the writing required before he raised them to the crowd, read one in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd so that the figure went twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, said The levy is called. It is not called by me and spoke of your house, never I, and went off toward High Kiln with the red cord folded square, the narrow slate and the box locked with the true subtraction inside, believing he had done the district a kindness, while the printed figure stood unchallenged and a figure read aloud was still not the figure paid and the figure over the basket was not the figure over the dressed grain under wool at home, the space between them with no signature and left apart, not averaged (T015/T041/T047, T077); the bell went from the Cross, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told (T078); before noon Hessa Rale took the slate up the clay road toward Greybank edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the second strap let out, the dried pale scurf of mud unbrushed on her shortened coat, and to a woman at the rail who asked what she carried she said I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which, answering the question put and not the one behind it, her record-first order of reaching the eighth such hand on a place of its own, advanced and not paid, no figure coming off the slate (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, slate to forearm and writing inward, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone and nobody stepping around him or taking him off (T090/T080/T083); across the square the seventh green stayed a colour at a silent woman's mouth with clay in her nail crescents, a pale line across the back of one hand and the sweetish green of glaze in the crease beside her lip, her cup turned a quarter and set back where it stood, and at the market's edge the seventh shape stayed a shape in cast-offs with a man's shoulders on a child's frame, silt pale in the wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver catching light and going dull, its head going toward a set-down pot a half-beat late and stopping in the middle of the turn, so that no eighth of either came, no second look was joined, no name was spoken, no loaf passed, no slate came near and no sale was made, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the telling (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); at the market's edge the hand went up an inch toward the river's low note and held to the river's own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and came down on the next low note, the fifty-third answer, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a hearing and not water over water promoted among the hearings (T061/T082); Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, and Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-nine days and no collector up or down the clay road on Grain 28, 29 or 30 (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); in the afternoon Grain went out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, Smoke unbrought, and in the small hours there was no breathing number anywhere in the house and the hand went up an inch, was taken through the small intake, hold and letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and came down on the river's next low note, the fifty-fourth answer, two rhythms in one inch remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule, so that fifty-four answers stood exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082); two hundred and thirty-nine stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and fifty-nine days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days, the widow's mark untouched with no opening in fifty-nine days, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the question over the boards with four askings and no witness and no fifth asking, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, Grain's third reading gone up the clay road in Berr's locked box and unread under this roof, and the count going forward exact and unspent into Day 240, Smoke 1, Firstday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101).
Day 240 | Smoke 1, Y.H. 813 (Firstday) | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle and kiln mouth, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the trough, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the boy came into his two hundred and fortieth day and six months and sixty days with nobody saying so, Smoke coming on without a boundary drawn and no market, Cross or bell, the carried fire's fifth unpaid for two hundred and forty days while fire under the floor, river through the finger's-width door and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the hand lay down against the fold after the fifty-fourth answer as a man lays a tool on a bench, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T061/T082, T036/T076); **the chapter's one meaningful change came before the kiln when Sella Vail, before the basket and any instruction, put her hand to the widow's mark at her throat, a thumb-length of lead-glazed clay with the Vail kiln scratched into it, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under the back of a broken pot, and the fire took, still answering four low pulls with the fifth missing, nobody seeing what it mended and no slate entered, lesson made, bond changed or payer named, and she put it behind the household without a word (T058/T079 and T088 advanced, not paid)**; she touched the mark at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk, for the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour, as on Tallow 1 and Ember 1; hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour Ash breath of the thaw, one leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; she gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, set the knife where six could be checked and the seventh could not, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping, kept nine stoppings and the Seed 16 breath unspent, and swept over the collector road without once turning along it, no collector coming up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T009/T013/T092); Jorra Vail parted meal-fine slate dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady), told a pot You'll do, knew its full note three turns ahead and withheld it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two and left he's not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand went up an inch toward the river's note, was taken through the small intake and came down at once against the fold, filed on the sixth place with no payer named as the fifty-fifth answer, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); at the going of the light she carried him home at the half-pace, going wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, left the thread frozen and went to her own bed before the small hours (T098 carried); in the small hours fire, river and boards kept three counts that did not become one, and the count went forward exact and unspent into Day 241.

Jorra Vail kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You'll do, withheld its note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, and when Sella's sentence went low and unfinished his bent finger went into the cold iron of the damper ahead of it, took the cold out, held and moved a hair's breadth, a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, with he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); no eighth green came and no eighth shape, no name spoken over either, no loaf, slate or sale, no fifth asking over the boards and no witness standing anywhere to be asked (T050/T051, T033/T034, T101 carried); in the small hours the three counts kept apart and the count stood at two hundred and forty-one, exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody.

the file was turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid with Grain's third arithmetic gone up the clay road in Berr's locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness (T061/T082, T101 carried); The house has said it, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf on his coat skirt brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure, a sleeve being no slate and a thing not priced being a thing whose payer has not been named; Sella lip-read the two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the mark untouched at shelf and hearth, for the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079, T100); **the chapter's one meaningful change came at the yard well, T080 advanced and NOT paid:** Ilva, a woman of the firing work of the yard and not of the house, drew a short strip of birch bark notched along one edge out of her sleeve and passed the nail of a thumb across the notches before her eyes went to the woman who asked and before her mouth answered Five to this morning, and the boy took the order of reaching and nothing else, setting a **ninth record-first hand-shape** on a place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair and fingers between it and the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand and the pale line, refusing to read the stick, ask her about it, join it to the reed-cutter's cord or let nine likenesses stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood to any; she was not Marra, not Hessa Rale, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not the grey-coated collector and not an officer, and nothing was sold, entered or explained (T080 advanced, unpaid); the hand went up an inch toward the river's low note with no count in the house to borrow, was held to the river's own low interval and came down on the next note, the sixty-third answer, and in the small hours went up, was taken through the small intake, held through the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept to the end of the count and brought down where the count ended, the sixty-fourth answer, one borrowed rhythm and one kept, the sixtieth coordination remembered and not a change made again, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); the boy turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it unchanged with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Grain's third subtraction locked in Berr's box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pan's gone ring and returning-line place on trays of their own, the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness, and now the ninth hand beside the eighth (T061/T082, T101, T098, T064, T050/T051, T033/T034 carried); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and forty-four days and no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092), Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not with nine stoppings and the Seed 16 breath unspent (T036/T076), and Jorra parted dust from slip, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two and held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, with unnamed men going low into the back room before first grey and getting no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light around the seven walked-around places, and in the small hours two hundred and forty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and sixty-four days told by nobody, the mark untouched, the seventh year still ungiven and Smoke 10 five mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 245, Smoke 6, Sixthday (T071/T072, T080, T061/T082).

the dressed grain came out from under wool for damp, was felt to the knuckle, spread thin on the flat stone to finish, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat, changed state and gained no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by a carrying arm that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); **then came the chapter's one meaningful change, the first Account-day and market of the second firing:** Sella set the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off, eight pigs went over the wet boards and two hundred leaned in, and Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read one in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, called the levy, denied it with your house never I, and went off up the clay road toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness (T015/T041/T047, T077 advanced, not paid), so that the district's arithmetic changed for the first time in Smoke and could not be changed back while the printed figure stood unchallenged, the figure read was still not the figure paid, the space between the figure read over the covered grain at home and what that grain had cost had no signature, and nothing answered for the man carried out on Day 188 or the hand that went in on Seed 15; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told and its gap not made a hearing or a seventh of the full note (T078, T061/T082), the hand went up toward the bell and held through the missing stroke and down on the next sound in the square, answer seventy-four, and Hessa Rale went up toward Greybank before noon with the slate edge-on and unread, answering I don't read it. I carry it, while the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T080, T090); at the going of the light Sella carried him home at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide with a look and no number around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough, the field's empty place and the returning-line place, set the basket on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, and said nothing of the reading, and two hundred and forty-nine stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody (T098, T060/T086, T009/T013/T092).

Day 261 | Smoke 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813 | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf's low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with thin white frost on its north stone lip and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the field's empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger's-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the boy came into his two hundred and sixty-first day and six months and eighty-one days with nobody saying so, the hand put down against the fold on the ninety-sixth answer as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, no bell, market or Cross on a Secondday, the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-one days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river through the finger's-width door and the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with Smoke's second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box, Smoke 30 eight mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon took the inventory in its old order and entered none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow's mark hanging, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, morning or dusk (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain was lifted at a corner for damp and laid back on the cool stone at the rack end with no figure, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 would not know what it cost and the space between the figure and its price stayed unsigned (T077); frost wrote thin white fronds on the north stone lip of the well where the Warm had lately gone out, the cold iron of the rope went over it, the bucket knocked the heads off it and the yard called the whole of it weather, while the boy kept whatever white had been there on a place of its own with no cause --- not a payer, not the widow's mark, for a well is not an opening, and not the first firing of Frost (T083/T085); a neighbour's cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-one days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat and crackless proverb intact, the uncalled tile debt circling without a name and neither paid nor settled, and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 22 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field's empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row not an account until a payer stands and none standing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don't count, set the knife at the lip with six checkable and the seventh not, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist's creases, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You'll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, and kept he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); Sella set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw and went to her own bed; the hand went up an inch toward the river's low note, held for the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, borrowing no house count (ninety-seven), and in the small hours held through one whole interval of the river's own going and came down on the next low note (ninety-eight), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, and 261 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath as the count went forward into Smoke 23 (T061/T082, T071/T072).

the boy watched as a surgeon watches a wound turned over and kept the finding that a thing can be handled closely and still enter nothing on a place of its own, not a lesson, a grievance or a doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings or his own kept gaps, for a joining would want a payer and none stood to either, the absence of a joining itself kept, entered nowhere and not spent (T077 advanced, not paid, T015/T041/T047 held, T061/T082); I keep the count, not the account --- so the boy filed no tenth hand-shape and the ninth stayed nine on its own tray with a finger between it and the eighth (T080 held); below the sill a child's foot that had stayed cold after the flood was wrapped in a woman's wool and called the cold by her and weather by the yard, the boy keeping the extremity going before the core and the afterdrop waiting beyond and naming no cause, no silt-leach and no cure, for there is no Grathic word for it and nobody in the yard has asked for one (T093/T094 carried, not paid); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not joined to the man carried out on Day 188, to any pot saying or to the pale line kept on its own place (T064); mid-afternoon, over the boards and not into the basket, a voice with no owner, room, hand at the kiln or cause said the row question again in a new form --- not a fresh asking but a report that somebody had been asking which row it went quiet on --- and the weather answered first, the price of barley after it, and the voice went off up the terrace with nobody leaning in to take an answer down; the boy took the shaping apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, found no witness at the bottom of it and set it beside the five askings with a finger between, the askings still at five with no sixth asking, no witness and no row named, the shaping not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a fifth telling of the burned slate at four, not a third telling of the shut counting room at two, not a fourth likeness of the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, not a cause, not a name and not a payment (T101 advanced and unpaid); Tarn at the kindling instructed the broom before taking it up, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don't count with six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed parted dusty forearms from clean, told a pot You'll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as one piece of iron with two bites, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the premature note apart, he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); a neighbour's cost-question went to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held); Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, counted under her breath toward no opening and went to her own bed, the widow's mark hanging where it hangs and the one opening before Smoke 1 staying behind the household with no lesson, mending, sign or payer (T058/T079); the hand held up an inch through one whole interval of the river's own going and came down on the next low note, borrowing no house count and supplying no stroke (one hundred and five), and in the small hours went up an inch for the small intake let go, then carried a second rhythm across the little silence after a count that had ended in the other room, the two intervals laid apart and not across one another, the silence kept whole and empty, and came down on the river's next low note (one hundred and six), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); 265 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath as the count went forward into Smoke 27 (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).

the hand went up an inch, held for the small intake and the hold of one of the breaths the woman counted in the room that does not touch and came down before the letting-go, borrowing no stroke and crossing no silence (one hundred and seven), then went up again, held for the small intake, the hold and the letting-go, did not come down with her breath, kept the small height through the little silence after her count and went on past the river's next low note to the one after it, holding across two of the river's intervals with no second house count borrowed for the second, the house's count kept on its own place, the river's two notes on another and the little silence between kept empty on a third, with no stroke supplied to agree any two (one hundred and eight), and the boy made nothing of the likeness to the examined grain and would not let it stand up as a gift; two hundred leaned in over the reading block and eight pigs went over the wet boards while an assessor of Sill wrote the eight down before anybody could ask which eight he meant; Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, passed a finger over the figure, held a narrow slate unopened to the forearm and read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, then called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, no figure coming off the slate and her eighth record-first hand staying advanced and not paid (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed Fishstairs clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with his slate inward and his hand to it before his eyes to the stalls, and nobody took him off (T090); the bell went over the market longer than a church bell, four, four and a gap, with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told bell of the Long Night and the gap not folded into the three counts under the roof, not heard as a seventh and not brought under any roof (T078, T061/T082); 269 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, one hundred and eight answers had become one hundred and fourteen and none was a reach, the seventh year stood at its very end and had still not given, Smoke went out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, Frost stood one morning ahead and was not reached for and the first firing of Frost (Day 271) was far off, and the file lay open on the towel with every tray parted and every gap left gap while the hand lay back against the fold on the hundred and fourteenth answer and the count went forward into Frost 1, a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).

the boy took the saying apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and set it on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between, a shaping toward the far-off day she must choose whether to read what she had carried for years, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a tenth hand, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and **not paid**, and did not join it to Ilva's strip a pace away, to Berr's twice-wiped thumb, to the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate, to Marra, to the charcoal or to any private keeping, nor let one stray saying stand up and call itself a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T080 advanced, **not paid**, T015/T041/T047); **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, passed a finger over a narrow figure, held the slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, read *one in twelve, as the notice says* low into the two hundred, sent the figure over the basket once for the moot and a second time for the households that came late, told the man at the rail who held a number up out of a fist that the figure stood as read and his household had heard wrong, called the levy for Frost and denied it with *The levy is called. the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself and stayed in the square beside the told bell, not folded into the three counts; at the pot board a silent woman with the sweetish green of lead glaze at one corner of her mouth, clay pale under her nails and a pale cord-mark across the back of one hand, turned a cup a quarter and set it back where it stood, and at the market's edge a child in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform never measured for him, with silt pale in his wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string at his throat, turned half a beat after a pot was set down, both sightings only, a colour and a shape with no eighth and no name, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration; at the yard well, **Ilva was seen again**, drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and fine rack dust worked into a thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a neighbour who asked what the month's firings had taken now the month was nearly out her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed there, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate on the stone lip and no figure coming off the wood, her eyes going to the asker after the hand settled and her mouth opening after both, answering Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account; the boy filed the order of reaching as the **ninth** record-first hand on a place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair, filed **no tenth**, took no figure off the wood, kept the slate's nearness as an absence and made her no reader, witness, party or story, and nothing of the exchange came under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment (T080 advanced, not paid); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid; Tarn at the kindling kept six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don't count and Yes, house to early and late, kept the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, the loan uncalled and no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, withheld the knowing of the full note, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, and he's not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-seven days and no collector up or down the road (T009/T013/T092); in the small hours the hand took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his at the end of the morning and let it go whole on the same note, filing the hundred and sixty-ninth answer, and another small intake at the very end of the day let go whole and unjoined, filing the hundred and seventieth, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082); the hand laid back against the fold, 297 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and seventeen days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the crust two inches off, the plate of ice clouded with silt out of the path of feet, and the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended and no thread opened or closed.

back under the roof **he very nearly laid the house's not-doings --- the two unswept lines, the mark untouched, the charcoal unread, the fire's fifth pull unsupplied, the loan uncalled, no number over the basket and the crust not lifted --- across his own empty intervals, and put the finger between instead**, for a joining would have wanted a payer under both and none stood, so the absence of the joining was itself kept and not spent on its own place with a finger between (T061/T082); a small dry scrape from the loft, the foot of a pot set down on stone, was filed on a place of its own and not joined to the fraction at the damper, the returned beat beneath the shelf or the flagstone half-check (T006 held, T062 held); **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred, sent the figure over the basket twice --- once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, told a man at the rail who brought a number up out of a fist that a number goes into a slate and there would be a slate at the watch, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and Frost's third true subtraction inside beside the first two, believing he had done a kindness; the district's arithmetic changed a third time for the month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid with no signature on the space between, and no figure answered for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the dressed grain lying covered under wool at the rack end, now read over a third time by a number that did not know what it cost (T015/T041/T047 advanced and not paid, T077); the boy kept the three Frost arithmetics on three places with a finger between, three and not one account, and kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, very nearly laying the three readings across the house's not-doings and his own gaps before putting the finger between, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine (T061/T082); the bell went over the square in the turn of the morning, longer than a bell in a temple yard, four strokes and four and the place where the fifth should have stood, with not one hand in two hundred going to a face, and stayed in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not folded into the three counts and not heard as a seventh (T078 held); Hessa took Berr's narrow slate up the road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered the women who asked with I don't read it. I carry it and Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, gave no figure off the slate, did not look toward the well and was not made a reader by any shaping (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey by midday and buyer's number entered before he looked up (T090 held); across the square the seventh green stood at a silent woman's mouth at the pot board, a cup turned a quarter and set back, and the seventh shape stood at the market's edge in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform never measured for him, each a colour and a shape with no eighth, no name and no joining to loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); in the quiet interval between the moot's reading and the late households' reading the boy held the space beside the twice-spoken figure with a finger between, filing the hundred and seventy-third answer as two sayings and not one account; at the going of the light Sella carried him home at the half-pace saying nothing, the bell's gap left in the square (T061/T082); in the Clay Yard she went wide around the seven walked-around places, Frost went out in its last tend without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months set right or left wrong, Tarn kept six and the seventh with the ear-sentence stopped as a remembered ninth stopping and no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, Jorra kept his dusty forearms and silence, put his bent finger into the cold damper, withheld the knowing of the full note, kept he's not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven, the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-nine days, the stayed frost, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate stayed weather entered nowhere, the three arithmetics stayed locked up the road, the grain stayed covered and unfigured, the three shapings stayed unpaid and the charcoal stayed unread; in the small hours the hand took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his at the very end of the day and let it go whole on the same note, not carried into the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap or the river's low note, filing the hundred and seventy-fourth answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082); the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid: an ownerless voice came up from Slate Row over the boards of the Clay Yard on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, saying a slate had been burned again, with no owner standing under it, no room, no hand at the flame, no reason, no name and no witness, and went off up the terrace while the yard went on with its work; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, by what was there and what was not, and set it on a place of its own beside the four earlier tellings (the one in Ember, the telling between, the one in Grain and the one after it) with a finger between every pair as the fifth telling of the burned slate, still not a third telling of the counting room shut in the war which stands at two, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a rule and not paid, five being five and not a rule and no sixth laid beside it (T035/T031/T065/T095 advanced, not paid), the seed held for the far-off calling-in of Jorra's promise to the men who burn slates, not a confession and not a payment, and Bone 10 able to carry it unchanged; Jorra, who knows the full note a slate-burner's pot gives three turns before it leaves his hands and withheld it from a High Kiln kiln-master, grew quieter whenever the saying went around the boards, with he's not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling's name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062); a pot whose handle had been mended twice stood on the pot board with two staples and the original crack showing, and the sayings went to the pot and the fire and never to a person, a repair that holds mending nothing anybody will name (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079); the hand entered the hundred and eighty-third answer as the half-beat between the pot's set-down and Sella going away laid beside a small intake with a finger between, and the hundred and eighty-fourth as the empty interval between the ownerless voice and the weather's answer kept empty and not filled to make a row come out even, each exact and worth nothing and no payer named (T061/T082); Sella kept the fire before the basket, the charcoal unread, the two gaps unfigured and the widow's mark untouched, Tarn kept six counted and the seventh held with the loan uncalled, Jorra kept the dust and the cold damper, Garl stayed in objects, and Bone 10 stood five mornings ahead unbrought.

the hand entered the hundred and eighty-fifth answer as a small intake let go whole on the same low note, a restraint and not a payment, and at the very end of the day the hundred and eighty-sixth as a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his let go whole on the river's note and carried into neither the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left in the square nor the river's low over lower, so that **one hundred and eighty-six** honest answers stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and no payer named to any (T061/T082); Day 309 | Bone 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813 | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then down to the Cross with the reading block under the moot-post and its finger's width of shade, the pot board, the market's edge, the square's Slate Row fringe, below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing, the rack end, the clay road up toward High Kiln and Greybank, and home at the going of the light to the bed, boards and towel under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | Bone 10 came on its own morning as the month's first Account-day and market, earned by that light and not brought into the day behind it, the count going from three hundred and eight to three hundred and nine exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-nine days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and nine days with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant's louder want with neither winning, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, and the five openings in five months kept as five and not a rule (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082, T058/T079, T100);
