It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, and went off up the clay road with the box locked and Bone's first true subtraction inside beside the three from Frost, believing he had done a kindness; four arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure, four are four and not one account, the figure read is still not the figure paid and no signature stands on the space, and the boy kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and did not lay it across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain covered under wool at the rack end, the four held changes or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047 advanced and not paid, T077, T061/T082); the bell went four, four and a gap with not one hand in two hundred going to a face and stayed in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not a seventh hearing of the full note, a fifth pull of the carried fire or an agreement with the boards' knot (T078 held); Hessa took Berr's slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, gave no figure off the slate and stayed the eighth record-first hand (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls and the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090 held); the seventh green stood at a silent woman's mouth at the pot board, a cup turned a quarter and set back exactly, and the seventh shape stood at the market's edge in cast-offs worn like a uniform never measured for him, turning half a beat after a pot was set down, each a seventh with no eighth and neither named Fenna or Ulda (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the fifth burned-slate telling went through the reading untouched with no owner, room, witness, hand at the flame, sixth or payer, gathering interest against Jorra's promise (T035/T031/T065/T095 held); the number that went over the covered grain did not know what it cost and answered nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the hare gone toward the north gate road (T077, T098 carried); at the going of the light she carried him home at the half-pace saying nothing, and in the small hours the hand let a small intake go whole on the river's note for the hundred and ninety-third answer and again at the close for the hundred and ninety-fourth, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the printed figure standing over a square gone quiet after the bell (T061/T082).
Day 310 | Bone 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813 | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger's-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | an ordinary Firstday came on with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from Bone 10 brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and tenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty days with nobody saying so, the count going 309 to 310 exact, the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and ten days with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order with the crust gone leathery two inches off, the thread still frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the ease on a cold face not ease and the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant's want with neither winning and the argument itself the work, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with four arithmetics now behind one printed figure and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082, T015/T041/T047); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, stood a moment counting small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed the grey streak back with the burn-wrist, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack, said both proverbs to the pot and the fire, set the rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow's mark because a morning and a hearth are not openings (T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T100); at the rack end the dressed grain was turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, the arithmetic that had gone over it on Bone 10 not brought back as a lesson and the unknowing kept on its own place with no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings, the returned half-check on the flagstones or his own gaps (T077, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, left the Seed 16 breath unspent with his chest tight since the dark, worked Ash into his knuckles, held the pale clip-ring to the grey and kept the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, with no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey dust, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, knew the full note that pot would give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, read one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, and kept the burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a step and no number, kept the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the trough's skin and the silt-clouded plate on its flat stone as three coverings called weather and entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, answered a woman who asked what the month's carrying had taken with the weather and a direction that left no entry, and kept the small keepings small --- charcoal unread beneath her finger, Ilva's strip in her sleeve offstage and her ninth hand nine with no tenth, the Frost 14 well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa's eighth hand, the seventh green and seventh shape with no eighth, the reed-cutter's cord and the clerk's inward slate --- none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment under the roof (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086, T083/T085, T077, T062/T035/T031, T080, T050/T051, T033/T034, T099, T090); Tarn's stroke went over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check and the returned half-check of Bone 8 stayed on the stone's own place with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 beat and the Frost 5 beat, four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause and no payer named, a thing kept by not being made again still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held); in the small hours the hand set an empty interval beside a held interval with the finger brought down between for the hundred and ninety-fifth answer and at the close set a small intake beside a letting-go with the half-beat of the pot's set-down laid beside them and none joined for the hundred and ninety-sixth, both exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air with no payer named, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river going low over lower under the finger's-width door (T061/T082).
Day 311 | Bone 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813 | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards, kindling and towel, the Debt Loft as a sound with a direction, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger's-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the twelfth came on in the small hours with no door opened and no hand lifted to mark it, no market, Cross or bell on a Secondday, the reading of two mornings ago gone up the clay road in a locked box and not brought back as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and eleventh day and six months and one hundred and thirty-one days with nobody saying so, the count going 310 to 311 exact and nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath able to say what it counted, the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and eleven days with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the crust gone leathery and brown-edged with its corner standing a hair off the wool two inches from his ear, the empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure and the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient will seem better before he is worse checked by the infant's want with both true, the second louder and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); the finding of four arithmetics behind one printed figure was not set beside anything to make it mean, the four true subtractions riding locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain under wool at the rack end, the four held changes on four places, the returned half-check on the flagstones or the small gaps in his own file, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between so that a finding with no payer could be carried light without becoming a rule (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket at first light, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the shelf's front edge and the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed the grey streak back with the burn-wrist, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack, said both proverbs to the pot and the fire, set the rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow's mark at shelf, well, rack, morning, hearth or bed because none was an opening and five openings in five months were five and not a rule with the next standing far off in a later month's first firing (T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T100); Tarn at the kindling had the knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked and slip, six years in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, Ash worked into his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist held up to the grey, his chest tight since the dark and the Seed 16 breath still unspent, told the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping, kept the warm stone she gave him in the winter Garl died cold in its unmarked pot in the loft, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey dust white in the creases, kept dusty and clean forearms apart as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, knew the note that pot would give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and would not say it before a High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's sentence and read one iron with two bites, gave the men who went low into the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, grew quieter as the burned-slate saying went around with the fifth telling standing at five, no witness, no hand at the flame, no sixth due on a day that had not earned one and the seed waiting on the far-off calling-in of his promise, he's not Vail sealed as tightly as a lid nobody had tried to lift in three years (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); Garl stayed in objects and not in a story --- the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg, the wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean and hollow that Sella let no one fill, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept both, the ridge measured by a thumb against the death-house ridge, the proverbs gone to pot and fire and never a person, and the debt against a firing of tiles circling without a name, neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled, his name unspoken three hundred and eleven days and the keeping of him maintenance and not a lesson (T009/T013/T092); in the going of the light she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the yard's hunts and repairs staying directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather and never figures, a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders saying Ask the weather. It carried the snow; it can carry the price and a barrow man told to ask the pot while no man priced a repair and stood up in the yard, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T077, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085); on the flagstones Tarn's stroke went over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and the returned half-check of the eighth stayed with the Day 161, Day 166 and Frost 5 changes as four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held); in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, nine record-first hands with Ilva's strip in a sleeve and no tenth, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, nothing spent to make a row come out even and nothing standing up as a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082, T078, T080, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076, T064, T065/T095); at the very end of the day the hand came up an inch toward the river's note, took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and let it go whole on the same note for the hundred and ninety-eighth answer, a restraint and not a payment borrowed from no house count and with no payer named, carried into neither the carried fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap in the square nor the river's low over lower, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the older man took a clean satisfaction in the keeping of the number, the infant wanted the crust lifted and the thread wiped, both true, the second louder and neither winning, and the hand came down on the river's note and laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it, three hundred and eleven standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, one hundred and ninety-eight honest answers on the sixth place, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet and Bone going on without a boundary drawn, nothing on the twelfth of Bone opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).

I keep the count, not the account, then putting the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and going back to the pail with nobody turning twice; the boy filed the order of her reaching as the **ninth** record-first hand on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth with a finger between, filed **no tenth**, made no figure of the slate's nearness and did not make her a reader of her own keeping, she being not Marra, not the soft-handed man, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not Hessa and not the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, with Bone 10's reading not come to her well (T080 advanced, not paid); a woman with a mended jar was sent to the pot with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sent the figure twice over the basket --- once for the moot and once for the late households --- called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, not made a reader by the fifth arithmetic and her eighth hand eight and not a rule (T080 advanced, not paid), while the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with hand to slate before eyes to stalls (T090 held), and a silent green-mouthed woman at the pot board and a foundling in cast-off clothes at the market's edge stood as a seventh of each with no eighth, no name and no loaf (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); in the afternoon Sella carried him home at the going of the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the three coverings staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and Ilva drew at the well with clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, to the woman who asked what the firings of Bone had taken put her hand toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate, the charcoal, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and answered Ask the pot what it cost. three counts stood in three places and did not become one --- the carried fire's four low pulls and its silent fifth, the boards' four nails and four and a thumb-width knot, and the river's water over water not numbered among the hearings --- with the bell's gap left in its square, six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told bell of the Long Night and the told figure beside the paid with no signature, and five arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, five readings five and not one account, the five true subtractions locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln and the finding on a place of its own with no payer not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, the edges so near to touching that a less careful hand would call the touching a cause and the finger going between (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047); the file lay open on the towel with the staying of Bone 15, the early letting-go of Bone 17, the handful and the thumb's resting each on its own place with a finger between and none made again, and four held changes on four places and not a rule; in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with the white gone off the north lip on Bone 3, the trough's skin breaking and closing under a pail's knock and the silt-clouded plate out of the path of feet, no fourth likeness standing up as a cause, the Cold Acre hare answering the price with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, both read as a chart left blank where the number should stand and entered nowhere, the fingers at the rack end going in and coming out empty with no handful lifted (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, set the knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked and slipped off, said Six counted. The next I don't count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight since the dark, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding light, the thumb's resting on the uncut seventh checked and not made again, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, while Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from any High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence with the iron's two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, and kept he's not Vail sealed (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 327 days and the tile debt circling without a name worse for being uncalled, and at the going of the light Sella carried him up and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, the loft a small dry scrape above and behind with no interior entered; the hand entered the **two hundred and twenty-ninth** answer in the first light and the **two hundred and thirtieth** in the small hours, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river's note, coming straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer and laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps, and **two hundred and thirty honest answers** stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; three hundred and twenty-seven stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty-seven days were told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door while Bone went on without a boundary drawn, two mornings short of the month's third and last reading and not brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086).

of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all, his hands large and clean and his thumb wiped twice on his apron before he touched nothing, once for the slate and once for the figure that would be on it, holding a narrow slate unopened against his forearm with the writing inward, passing a finger over the figure and letting his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, reading One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sending the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, never looking into the basket; he called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and to a man who brought a number up out of a fist he said Your house wants it again, there'll be a slate at the watch; he said something low to the block about kindness being entered, to which the block answered nothing, and went off up the clay road with the cord folded, the narrow slate under his arm and the box locked, Bone's third true subtraction riding inside beside the five that had gone before, believing he had done the district a kindness. **The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:** six arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure, six are six and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and a rule made from six refused for want of a payer; the boy kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and did not lay it across the not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between; the reading answered nothing for the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the dressed grain under wool or the carried fire's missing fifth (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on to her forearm with the writing turned to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, saying I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk, her eighth hand staying eighth with no tenth, no figure coming off the slate, no fourth shaping made and no reader or witness made of her (T080 advanced, not paid); the bell went four, four and a gap, longer than a church bell, with the gap where the fifth should have stood and nobody crossing himself, staying in its square beside the told bell; below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk sat set at the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, his hand to his inward slate before his eye went up to the stalls, the market selling over him as water goes over a stone, and at the pot board a green-mouthed woman turned a cup a quarter and set it back while at the market's edge a shape in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform stood where the light did not fall squarely, each filed as the seventh of its kind with no eighth, never named Fenna or Ulda and joined to no loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance (T078, T090 held, T050/T051, T033/T034); in the moot-post's shade the hand entered the **two hundred and thirty-third** answer, small intake held whole and let go on the river's note and straight down, the note having done before the hand came down, so neither early nor stayed; back in the yard at the going of the light the Cold Acre hare was answered with the weather, the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, and a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year would want while two fence-menders said the thaw would be early and late, Tarn saying Yes, house to each and keeping the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument could find a foot, with no collector up or down the clay road; the whole holding tray was checked unchanged, Tarn's thumb's resting on the uncut Seventh held as one object not made again on Bone 28, 29 or 30, a touch that took nothing and paid nothing and was kept because it was true, the handful, the staying and the early letting-go each on its own place and not made again, four held changes on four places and not a rule, six hearings with the seventh empty, nine hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, five openings in five months with the sixth far off at Ash 2, Jorra at the shed's edge parting dusty forearms from clean and putting his bent finger into the cold damper with he's not Vail sealed, Garl kept in objects with his name unspoken 329 days and the tile debt uncalled, and Sella setting him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold righted and the thread left; at the very end the hand entered the **two hundred and thirty-fourth** answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, and **two hundred and thirty-four honest answers** stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; the widow's mark hung untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months being six and not a rule and no seventh made due; the private tray was checked and left as it lay — six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell beside the told with four, four and a gap and nobody crossing himself, nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the row at five askings with one shaping and no sixth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning each on a place of its own with a finger between, none spent, named, joined or promoted into a witness or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood, the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together still far off and not his; in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places again with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause, the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured with no handful lifted, the Cold Acre hare went to the weather, the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and to a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn said *Yes, house* to each and kept the late because it puts off the paying; at the kindling he kept six and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, the Ash 14 held breath found where it had been set and not made again, said *Six counted. The next I don't count*, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, grew quieter, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth of anything, and no runner or collector came on any road; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 350 days and the tile debt uncalled; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped; the hand entered answer **275** in the small hours and **276** at the close, each a small intake held whole on the river's note and coming straight down as a man puts away a tool, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, and **276 honest answers** stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none calling itself a doctrine; nothing on the twenty-first was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the pot's hairline showed between old-brass staple and tighter wire, one stiff brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and the thread frozen and unwiped, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood nine mornings ahead and was named only as a date, forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T098, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held).

weather answered first, a wrong wind off High Kiln carrying the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and touching the fold and going out on the wind that brought it, the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went up the terrace while nobody leaned in to take the answer down; her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed it and dark in the uncut grain between, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, to the cord or to any saying that arrived nowhere, no figure coming off the wood, and with eyes to the asker and mouth opening after both with a half-beat she answered the question put and not the one behind it, *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, then put her flat hand once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, nobody turning twice; the boy took the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and filed it as the ninth record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth and no tenth, made no reader of her keeping, joined her to none, and expressly did not make her the speaker of any voice, no voice coming at that well and no fifth shaping of the saying (T080 advanced, not paid)**; Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, chest tight and Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, checked the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, said *Six counted. The next I don't count*, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006); **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082):** Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot *You'll do*, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of her instruction arrived at the pot and the household straightened around the waiting as cloth straightens when a weight is lifted — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — and then, after the tongue had been moved and the sentence finished and the household straightened, after the work was done and not before, **left the bent finger in the cold iron a breath longer than the work required**, making no song of it, naming it to nobody, not looking toward the basket, giving no name to the men in the back room and not saying the room was cold; the boy took the interval apart by what was there and by what was not and filed it on a place of its own with a finger between it and the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and his own gaps, a private keeping gathered once and not spent, expressly **not** a sixth held object, not a seventh, not an eighth of anything, not a habit, not a way, not a hearing, not a near-full answer, not a mending, not a cause, not a payment and not a rule, with no payer standing under it, gathering toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together, and that hand not his; he did not join it to Jorra's dust, the damper's double bite, the uncalled debt, the covered grain, the charcoal, Ilva's strip or the Ash 23 direction, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, and *he's not Vail* stayed sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn and the claim gathering interest against it; the whole file was turned out on the towel and checked and left, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, heard bell beside told, eight arithmetics eight and not one account, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the three directions apart, and the new holding on its own place beside the five objects, the pot-crack resting and the hand-at-the-sill breath; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth of anything and none was supplied to make a row come out even; at the going of the light Sella carried him up wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen; in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note's own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer **285** in the morning and answer **286** at the close, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, **286 honest answers** standing on the sixth place; Ash kept its twenty-sixth day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood four mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082 advanced, not paid; T080 advanced, not paid; T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T015/T041/T047, T078, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held).

Sella went to the hearth before the basket with the whole old grammar, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot's back, said *The house will keep it*, counted intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept the charcoal unread beneath her finger, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first with both proverbs and the hairline showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful and set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, then carried him down before first light at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, set the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, put the fold right under his chin with the back of one knuckle and stood half a pace off through the reading and said nothing to the wicker (T058/T079/T100, T077); **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047):** Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiped his thumb twice on his large clean apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate inward to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure through his sleeve and let his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, read *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by and sent it twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with *The levy is called. It is not called by me* and *your house*, never I, said something low to the block about kindness being entered to which the block answered nothing, and went off up the clay road with the cord folded, the slate under his arm and the box locked, Ash's third true subtraction riding inside beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone, believing he had done a kindness with no anger and no triumph in it; **nine arithmetics of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure, nine and not one account**, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of nine, expressly not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the holding of Ash 26, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction or the boy's kept gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, and the reading answering none of the held questions and buying no lesson under the Vail roof; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell staying in its square beside the told bell and not folded into the three counts with six hearings beside and never among and the seventh place empty (T078, T061/T082); before noon Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank with the second strap let out, dried pale road-mud scurf unbrushed on the shortened skirt, the writing turned to her sleeve and nothing pressing where the writing was, and answered *I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which* and *Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk.*, a runner and not a reader with the eighth record-first hand and no tenth (T080); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, his slate inward and his hand to slate before eye to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone and nobody taking him off (T090); at the market's pot board a silent woman with the seventh green at one mouth-corner turned a cup a quarter and set it back, and at the market's edge a small shape in cast-offs caught the light on a green sliver and went dull, a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, unnamed, never Fenna or Ulda, not joined to Berr's green, to each other or to any hearing, cause or romance, and the foundling's half-turn after the knock was a turn and not a hearing (T050/T051, T033/T034); Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of where they had been or what had been read over the wicker, came to the hearth before the basket under the roof, left the thread frozen and unwiped, and kept the widow's mark untouched, for a market, a Cross, a going of the light and a reading are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh was made due (T058/T079); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, went widest around the returning-line place, kept the three coverings weather with a finger between every pair, lifted no handful of the dressed grain, and sent the hunts and repairs as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather while a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and went on about its business, nobody tasting it twice (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085, T077); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, found the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the four held changes on four places and not a rule, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006), while Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot *You'll do*, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and did not leave the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031); the whole file came out on the towel and was checked and left as it lay, nine arithmetics nine and not one account, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings with no witness, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction apart with a finger between every pair, three counts in three places that did not become one, and nothing promoted by the reading (T061/T082, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); the hand came up an inch toward the river's note, held a small intake whole on the note's own finishing, came straight down and filed answers 293 in the small hours after the reading and 294 at the close, 294 honest answers standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine; the count closed at 359 exact because the day closed and not because anybody called it, the surgeon taking his cold satisfaction in a field left as found and costing nothing, which was how he knew it was not the same as peace, while the infant went on wanting the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning; no collector came up or down the clay road, no runner came on any road, and no second reading, green-mouthed woman sighting, foundling sighting or ownerless voice came in the afternoon; Ash went out without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months was set right or left wrong, and Stone came on in the dark beyond the door and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, its first firing standing far off, the boy's first birthday on Stone 7 (Day 366) beyond that and the Hearth Drawing on Stone 12 (Day 371) further still, none named to him under any roof; forward, not closed.

Day 389 | Stone 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813, the year's third and last Account-day and market | under the Vail kiln-house roof in the dark before first light and again in the small hours at the year's close, then down the nineteen steps through the Clay Yard's seven walked-around places, widest around the returning-line place, to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, the pot board across the square with eight pigs going over the wet boards and a Sill assessor writing them down, the road up toward High Kiln, \place{the north bridge} and the out-of-line landing below it, the market's edge, and back under the Vail roof at the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the thirtieth came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning, the year's third and last Account-day and market with a slate read under the moot-post and a bell, nothing from the twenty-eighth or twenty-ninth crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 388 to 389 exact, six months and 208 days becoming 209 told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken 389 days with their payer and their man unnamed, the body taken in the surgeon's old order with crust, gap, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon's knowing that a basket set level out of the draught is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for checked by the infant's louder want with both true, neither winning (T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, saying *The house will keep it*, neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on the shelf's top edge, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, market and going of the light and bed not openings and no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100), carrying him down before first light at the half-pace from every open slate, setting the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell with no instruction and no reason to the basket, and carrying him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over the wicker, fold right at ear and chin with no second fold; **Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure through his sleeve, read *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by and sent the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with *your house*, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, said something low to the block about kindness being entered, and went off up the road with the cord folded, the slate under his arm and the box locked, Stone's last true subtraction riding inside beside the eleven before it, believing he had done a kindness with no anger and no triumph — the belief that will one day be remembered against him (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid)**; the boy filing the **twelve arithmetics** — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, and Stone's first, second and last — twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, twelve true subtractions locked in Berr's box with the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key, not laid across the keeping at the fold, the four rooms' gap, the four directions or any of his own gaps, and the hand that would lay them together and the payer under them not standing; Berr's order of reaching filed on a tray of its own beside the other record-first hands with no tenth; bell four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, its gap kept beside the told and not folded in (T078); Hessa Rale up the road toward Greybank before noon with the narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, *I don't read it. I carry it* and *Ask the road*, her eighth staying eight and no figure coming off the face of it (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090 held), a silent woman with the sweetish green of lead glaze at the pot board turning a cup a quarter and a small shape in cast-offs at the market's edge, a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, unnamed, never Fenna or Ulda, joined to no loaf, slate, sale, hearing or cause (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the dressed grain covered under wool read over by a figure that did not know its cost (T077); answers 353 and 354 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, Stone keeping its thirtieth day without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month holding both names neither set right nor left, the year going out as it came in without a line across it, twelve readings standing behind one unsigned figure and nothing under the roof standing up and calling itself an account, the surgeon's only victory a refusal that cost him nothing, the infant getting none of the three wants, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year, Jorra's promise neither given nor withdrawn, the cold foot uncured and the second chill's cause withheld, the Five standing beyond and not brought in, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.

to the slate *The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded* in an ordinary writing hand with no pause, catch or small check from first word to last, the boy filing the order on a tray of its own with a finger between it and the neat dark hand, Hessa Rale's eighth, Ilva's ninth, Berr Clay's twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and the Drawing collector's ordinary hand, expressly not Marra, not the Court-table clerk, not the Fishstairs clerk and not the Drawing collector, no tenth hand standing up in the empty place, and the man going away believing he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going — the belief, not anger or triumph, that will one day be remembered against him (T080/T090 advanced, NOT paid)**; the neighbour under the tube giving a small sound low in the throat and showing a pale round place on her arm, not a wound and no blood, covered with her sleeve and written on no tray, expressly not a seventh hearing with the six standing beside and never among and the seventh place empty (T061/T082); twelve arithmetics standing behind one unsigned figure with no thirteenth brought into a holy day, the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the heard bell beside the told with neither gap folded into the fire's four and a gap, the Drawing's flat knock outside the hearings, four rooms with the same gap held apart, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions standing where put and not repeating and buying no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095/T101 held), no ownerless voice coming over the boards; the keeping in the crust's empty place found where put and still a finding with no second fold, no third crust, no name and no payer, the far-off finger that would lay shelf and fold together still far off, not his and not come (T097/T060/T086); answers 355 and 356 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon's satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing and was not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, Tarn's loan uncalled and Jorra's promise ungiven, the cold foot uncured and the second chill's cause withheld, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.
Day 391 | Weighing, Y.H. 813, the second of the Five | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours, the finger's-width door and the river under its winter skin, then the nineteen steps down into the Clay Yard and up the path from the reading, the yard well, the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate, the skinned trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field's empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill and six pieces in the worn thumb-mark, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the back room and the cold damper, the pot board and the bed under the roof at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the second of the Five came the way weather comes, a day with a name and no tend-day and no market and no boundary drawn, the Kindling measure staying on its own tray with a finger between it and the reading and buying no lesson here, nothing from Kindling crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 390 to 391 exact, six months and 210 days becoming 211 told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken 391 days, the body taken again in its old order of leathery crust, fold found where put, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon's knowing checked by the infant's louder want with both true and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, saying *The house will keep it*, counting intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat, and the widow's mark untouched, no eighth made due on a holy day (T058/T079/T100); **the word of the reading came up the yard in the middle of the morning not as news or command but as a voice people had been holding in the ear and repeating without meaning to, a woman saying it to a pail, a man to a coil of rope, a girl to the dust, wearing the grammar of the Cross in a temple's clothes, calm and clean with no gravel, haste or catch, the speaker taken neatly out of his own sentences as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, announcing a whole return for somebody absent from every room in the yard — measure kept, account squared, a person made whole again on a slate — saying the name cleanly once and going on to the next measure without saying it again, the yard taking up the grammar and leaving the space where the name had stood as a ledge keeps the round pale place where a cup stood, the household not repeating the name under this roof and the boy writing it into no file and looking toward no house, keeping the silence after it on the gap tray beside the told bell's gap and the unfigured spaces with no payer standing and no cause written across it, not letting it stand up as a witness, a reader or a payment, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T080/T090 advanced, NOT paid)**; the speaker not Berr Clay, not the Sill assessor and not the Drawing collector, filed apart on a place of his own, joined neither to the Kindling collector's ordinary hand, the neat dark hand, Hessa Rale's turned wrist nor the four directions, no tenth hand and no reader made by being clean, the four rooms that keep the same gap — the birth room in House Silt, the Vail kiln-house, the market-day slate room and the Drawing house — staying four with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth likeness (T081); in the afternoon the yard going around its seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings and the river's winter skin entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, the field keeping its empty place; **Tarn taking the broom only after Sella's words had gone to the bristles, bent at the shoulders from six years in the slip pit with grey Ash worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line and the pale clip-ring at his left wrist giving back the little light, asking the weather for the hare's price and a pot for the cracked jar's firing and saying *Yes, house* to the kindling woman and to the fence-menders wanting the thaw early and late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument found a foot; at the kindling six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand passing over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, cutting nothing, counting nothing, spending nothing and saying *Six counted. The next I don't count*, the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting found where put and not made again beside the five held objects and the pot-crack resting with a finger between every pair, his ear-sentence about the ear worth more than the debt brought all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent at the top of the reach, no look along the road, a term ending not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom but a leaving more exposed, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure and unsaid, and what he wanted a slate with his own name on it and no mark against it though he thought he wanted freedom and needed a way to keep warm without being spent (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082)**; **Jorra coming through the finger's-width door off the Vail wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, three or more men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey with no name and no word that the room was cold from him, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead with air and a want in it and withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early and sing a pot before its time, his bent finger going into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, taking the cold out of the fingertip, moving the tongue a hair's breadth and leaving itself standing so that the end of her instruction arrived at the pot, one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, the extra holding of Ash 26 not made a second time, neither looking at the other nor saying what the iron had been asked to carry, *He's not Vail* sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031)**; the silence after Weighing's name, Tarn's stopped ear-sentence and Jorra's ungiven promise checked on three separate places with a finger between every pair and not let stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood; answers 357 and 358 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, the carrying fire fifth unpaid under the floor, the keeping still a finding, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine, the four directions standing where put and not repeating, the colder foot uncured and the second chill's cause withheld, Tarn's loan uncalled and Jorra's promise ungiven, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.
Day 392 | the Long Night, Y.H. 813, the third of the Five | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the dark with no fire after dusk, the finger's-width door and the river under its winter skin, then the nineteen steps down through the Clay Yard's seven walked-around places and back up at the going of the light, the doorsteps, the flat stone by the well and an overturned pail outside a house whose fire had also been banked early where the neighbours sat telling the Return, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | the third of the Five came as weather comes, a day with a name and no tend-day and no market and no boundary drawn, the measure taken on Kindling and the clean voice of Weighing staying behind the household and buying no teaching here, the count going 391 to 392 exact, six months and 211 days becoming 212 told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken 392 days with its payer and its man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken in the surgeon's old order of crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, fold found where put and no second fold, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for, a face composed by cold not composure and pink returning the surface still lying over a cold core, checked by the infant's louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, neither winning and the quarrel the work (T060/T086); Sella banking the fire early against the going of the light, telling the coals it was the thaw where another woman would say I, saying *The house will keep it* to the pot, counting intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing between old brass and tighter wire, both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carrying him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, going around the seven places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, setting him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold right at his ear and under his chin and no second fold, and the widow's mark not touched because the dark was not an opening and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule with no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100); no fire lit after dusk, the house sitting down into the dark holding its own shape the way a vessel holds what it has with a crack nobody mentioned, four low pulls under the floor and the silence where the fifth should have stood with nobody lifting the floor and nobody supplying the pull (T088); the yard's neighbours making ready for the dark and passing the bell as four, four and a gap from mouth to mouth as a coal is passed in a dish, each house saying it had kept the count and none saying where the count began, no bell rung, the told bell kept in its square beside the bell heard from the Cross, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's four and a gap, the boards' four and four and a thumb-width knot or the twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure and not made a seventh hearing or a fourth count, three counts in three places staying three because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood (T078, T061/T082); the stories of the Return going around among the seven places with gaps the shape of vessels' intervals, a pause where a name should stand, a space where a counting should be, an interval that was not a hearing though it had the shape of one, a woman saying the count had stopped at four in her grandmother's time and the fifth been left for the weather with a small intake before the word, a man whose voice had been at the well saying a name called from the Cross had gone on being a calling after the caller went away, neither with a figure or a source standing, the boy making no seventh hearing of any story and not laying a story's gap across the told bell's gap, the silence after Weighing's name or his own kept spaces, for two gaps agreeing would want a payer put under both and none stood; **one neighbour telling of a whole return announced in a clean voice for somebody not in any room to hear it, the Cross's grammar in his mouth and a temple's clothes on his meaning, coming to the place where a name would stand and leaving it standing empty while nobody in the dark supplied it, his voice going quiet there with the exact weight of a thing set down and not picked up and then going around it as a man steps around a hole in a floor he has not been asked to mend, the boy putting that quiet on the gap tray beside the told bell's gap, Weighing's missing name, the crust's two inches, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place and the unfigured spaces with a finger between every pair and writing no payer over it and no cause across it, not letting it stand up as a witness, a reader, a payment or a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood**; **the single present-tense break earned by the form of that announcement and untagged: *The page over the speakers says a name. The white room does not look up, and his hands stay in the field.* Then it was the Long Night under the Vail roof again and nothing had been paid, the form shown for two sentences and gone back into the mouth where it is kept, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, the unsent call to Nina paid on Day 38 and expressly not paid again, and the boy bringing no other room across, for a man who brings a whole room across for two sentences will end by putting a payer under both lives and none stood under either (T020 not paid again)**; the bell told once more before the stories were done, four, four and a gap, the heard bell staying heard and the told staying told, the boy setting no hand to join the three counts; the keeping found where put and still a finding with thirteen findings standing and no fourth crust or second fold, Tarn's loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year with the Seed 16 breath unspent and Jorra's promise neither given nor withdrawn though neither man came under the roof this night, the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, four rooms keeping the same gap with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought in as a fifth likeness, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine and their twelve true subtractions locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions standing where put and not repeating and buying no lesson, no voice coming over the boards, and nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended; the file coming out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done with every gap left gap, the river keeping its note of water over water under its winter skin beyond the finger's-width door and the note having done before any hand came down; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch toward the note, not reaching, taking a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holding the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the covering, letting it go as the note ended and laying itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the letting-go neither early nor stayed and the hand not staying; answer 360 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold, the surgeon's small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing and was not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with the Remembering, the Last Day and Ilmen 1 of Y.H. 814 standing beyond the dark, unbrought, forward, not closed.

ownerless voice over the boards, the four old directions standing where put and buying no lesson, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.
