Day 395 | Ilmen 1, Y.H. 814, Firstday | under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf's low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash where no broom had gone in two years, the place in the Clay Yard where the yard's grey was swept into a low ridge along the wall, fed into a shallow heap on the bare clay and burnt with a coal so that a thread of smoke went up straight and then lay flat along the ground, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place where the yard went widest, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate on the flat stone, the drying racks with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling with the knife at its sill and Garl's unforged collector sentence, the flagstones, the finger's-width door and the river under its winter skin, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath | Ilmen 1 came on its own morning with the tend begun again as a fact of the Court's counting and not an act of anybody under this roof, a Firstday on which the year turned with nothing signed, no boundary drawn on the floor and no signature standing on the space, nothing from the Last Day crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count carried in exact at 394 into a morning that had not earned a figure, the year's first arithmetic standing nine mornings off at Ilmen 10 and not brought in (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid), the count going 394 to 395 exact, six months and 214 days becoming 215 told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken 395 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088); the body taken in the surgeon's old order at the coming and going of the light and in the small hours, crust gone harder in the dry heat with its corner a hair off the wool, fold found where put and not made again, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the infant's three wants quarrelling without verdict and getting none of the three (T060/T086, T097); **the yard burning the grey the Last Day had left in the corners and a neighbour calling it gone and dealt with while the woman with the rake noticed the ridge still lying along the Vail wall and said You'll have that too, Widow, now the rest is up, Sella telling the broom where to stand and giving neither woman nor man an answer, and the boy keeping the neighbour's called-gone grey on one place beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner with a finger between, a thing called finished not finished for being called so and the Ash's memory not spent, explained or promoted into a sign, the chart he had once signed saying a wound was closed when the surface had only come together over a cold cavity coming up without being asked and going back without a payer (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085)**; Sella's grammar resumed as though nothing had turned, hearth before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the broken pot's back, neither gap figured, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, the clay jar glanced at with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow's mark hanging where it hung and not touched because a burning and a Firstday were not openings and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T077); the yard's seven places gone around once and not twice and widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings and the river's skin weather entered nowhere and found where put and not spent on the burning or the turning of a year (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085); **the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 carried across into Y.H. 814 unchanged behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash and Stone's first, second and last — twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, their twelve true subtractions locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket and no key in the boy's hand, the reset supplying no payer to the old twelve or a new one, and the boy not laying his twelve old findings across a new figure to make a row come out even (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid)**; in the small hours the file coming out on the towel as instruments come out when a case is done, every gap left a gap — the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap, the silence after Weighing's name, the place the Remembering did not fill, the neighbour's called-gone grey and the left-in-place ridge on two places, Tarn's stopped ear-sentence at the very end of a term already ended, Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn and Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch — **nine record-first hands standing with no tenth** (Hessa's eighth with her slate up the road unread, Ilva's ninth with her strip in her sleeve, Berr's twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing, the Drawing collector's ordinary hand, the Kindling collector's ordinary hand with its belief that will one day be remembered against him, the neat dark hand, Marra's and the finger beneath the shelf, the clean-voice speaker filed apart), nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside, heard bell beside told with three counts in three places staying three, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the four Ash/Slate directions held apart, green a colour and the foundling a shape with no eighth, the cold foot uncured and the second chill's cause withheld, the river under its skin beside water over water, four rooms with the same gap held apart and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth, every one advanced and none paid, and no silences stood up together and called themselves a rule (T061/T082, T080/T090, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T081, T078); through the finger's-width door the river keeping its note of water over water under the winter skin, a covering put on by the cold and taken off by the cold entered nowhere and not a hearing or a sign, the note having done before any hand in the room came down; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch toward the note, not reaching, taking a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holding the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the covering, letting it go as the note ended and coming straight down and laying itself flat against the fold on answer **366** as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, six honest answers standing on the sixth place from these three days and 366 since the first, not one a doctrine; the surgeon's small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing and not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the Opening of the Slates come and gone with a yard burning its grey and a household that said nothing and left no signature, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with Ilmen 10 nine mornings off, forward, not closed.
